AMI Gen7 
The New Generation of C-SAM Technology.  The most sophisticated and fully featured C-SAM acoustic microscope for laboratory analysis and specialized high resolution applications. 
 Contact Us 
 Download Brochure 
Overview
The Gen7 C-SAM is the latest generation in Acoustic Micro Imaging. Built on the advancement made by its predecessors, the Gen7 delivers the most advanced hardware available on a C-SAM instrument. The advanced hardware allows for new features and analysis that can now be completed faster than ever before.
Advanced features such as PolyGate, SonoSimulator, Virtual Rescanning Mode (VRM) and Frequency Domain Imaging (FDI) add value and confidence. With its large, easy access illuminated scanning area, the Gen7 has the capability to efficiently scan everything from a small part to a large 350mm wafer chuck.
In addition to being packed with leading innovations, the Gen7 was designed with the user in mind. Its ergonomic features make it comfortable and convenient to use. The new Sonolytics 2 is an advance operating software with new intuitive operator interface menus which help maximize results, while saving operator time.
The Gen7 is truly the most advanced C-SAM, delivering a package of technology, ergonomics, and advanced Nordson Test & Inspection - developed features that cannot be found anywhere else.
Features:
See more of the image on dual 28" 4k monitors.
Do more with advance user inferface Sonolytics 2 for Windows 10.
Higher accuracy with up to six times the acquisition rate.
Expanded scanning area by 23% for your largest sample needs
The fastest acquisition times with 5 independent motors.
Specifications at a Glance 
Gen7 snapshot of specifications (please download brochure for all specifications.) 
Gen7 details: 
Scan Area  
350 mm x 350 mm 
Z-axis movement 
170 mm 
X-axis Motor 
2x linear rod motor 
Y-axis Motor 
2x linear rod motor 
Z-axis Motor
Servo Motor/Lead Screw 
Operating System 
Windows 10 and Sonolytics 2 
Computer Hardware 
Intel i7/SSD-HD 
Digitizer 
Up to 6 GHz with 12 bits 
Image Resolution 
Up to 32K by 32K image resolution 
Monitors 
Dual 28 inch 4k monitors 
Tabletop Configuration 
Straight and curved 
USB 
USB 3.0 
Counter Weight 
Linear Motor driven 
Easy to Set Up 
Fully automated - a single button starts a scan of multiple areas and auto aligns.  
Fastest acquisition times 
 Five high speed scanning motors to deliver faster scan speeds and minimal vibrations. 
Scan larger parts! 
 The Gen7 has a 23% larger scan area which securely captures images and has advanced triggering tools to obtain the perfect image.

Plasma treatment 
Plasma Treatment 
Before Anything Else, Surface Preparation 
Comprehensive Plasma Surface Treatment Solutions—and Expert Guidance on Selecting the Ideal Plasma Mode 
In electronics manufacturing, plasma surface treatment is essential for improving adhesion, reliability, and process yield across critical assembly and packaging steps. By removing contaminants and activating surfaces at a molecular level, plasma enables stronger bonds for processes such as die attach, wire bonding, underfill, molding, and conformal coating. Nordson offers a broad range of plasma treatment solutions that support Primary (Direct and Reactive Ion Etch), Secondary, and Secondary Ion‑Free Plasma modes—each delivering a different balance of chemical activity, ion energy, and UV exposure. Understanding these plasma modes helps manufacturers select the optimal Nordson plasma system to achieve effective plasma cleaning and surface activation while protecting sensitive devices.
Get started by watching the video for a high‑level overview of our full range of plasma systems, then dive deeper into individual plasma modes by exploring the articles linked in the Related Articles section below. 
MARCH Plasma Treatment Solutions 
This video showcases the full portfolio of Nordson MARCH plasma treatment solutions designed for semiconductor and printed circuit board assembly. As the essential first step before processes, such as underfill and conformal coating, Nordson MARCH plasma systems remove organic contaminants and activate surfaces to ensure optimal adhesion, improved process consistency, and enhanced reliability. From R&D to high‑volume production, these scalable plasma solutions help manufacturers meet the most demanding performance and quality requirements.

Acoustic Microscopy 
Acoustic microscopes for both Laboratory and Production Floor environments. 
 Welcome to AMI 
Leaders in C-SAM tools for non-destructive internal inspection and analysis. 
Nordson TEST & INSPECTION is the most trusted authority on the application of Acoustic Microscopy, also known as Acoustic Micro Imaging (AMI) technology for nondestructive internal inspection and analysis.
Nordson TEST & INSPECTION's C-SAM acoustic microscopes are recognized as the benchmark for accuracy.  You’ll benefit from the unmatched expertise of our dedicated acoustic applications engineers. Our engineers represent the leading minds in AMI and regularly receive industry recognition and awards, including the prestigious IEEE Rayleigh Award.
 Our Products 
Embrace the Future of Wafer Inspection 
Introducing SpinSAM as a game changer in the fast-paced world of semiconductor manufacturing. With extremly high throughput, precision and efficiency without sacrificing accuracy. Laboratory AMI Inspection Systems 
 The most popular, sophisticated and fully featured C-SAM acoustic microscopes used worldwide for routine laboratory analysis and specialized high resolution applications for component screening.

Production AMI Inspection Systems 
 These fully featured C-SAM acoustic microscopes used worldwide for accelerated throughput as well as semi-automated screening of microelectronic devices on the manufacturing floor.
 View More 
Applications 
Microelectronics 
 Hidden defects such as delaminations, cracks and voids within a microelectronic application can lead to catastrophic failure of the device. Nordson TEST & INSPECTION's Acoustic Micro Imaging has always been the most trusted technology for nondestructive inspection of microelectronics. 
 View More 
Power & Energy 
 Consistency and precision in the thermal interface can be the difference between exceptional performance and early failure. Nordson TEST & INSPECTION's C-SAM® acoustic microscopes can precisely measure material thickness and bonding consistency in a solar application, detecting voids, delaminations and imperfections in bond materials before problems occur. 
Automotive 
Military & Aerospace 
MEMS, Wafers & Seals 
Materials & Composites 
 When a circuit is being used in an aerospace, military or automotive application, a component failure can be a matter of life and death. Nordson Test & Inspection has extensive experience with nondestructive testing for MIL-SPEC and High-Rel devices. 
 Delaminations and voids can compromise the hermiticity of MEMS devices. Nordson Test & Inspection's C-SAM® acoustic microscope technology delivers the next generation of innovation for MEMS inspection, finding the defects that hermetic testing just can't detect. 
 Invisible defects such as surface cracks, voids, delaminations and internal porosity flaws can ruin the performance of a component. Nordson Test & Inspection's Acoustic Micro Imaging (AMI) techniques detect these material-weakening flaws better than any other inspection method. Sonoscan systems nondestructively inspect materials layer by layer, delivering accurate and comprehensive analysis for product development, failure analysis and process control insights.
